week1_tips: Start taking folic acid if yu planning fi get pregnant.
week3_tips: Yu might not know yu pregnant yet.
week4_tips: Yu can tek a pregnancy test if yu period late.
week5_tips: Morning sickness might start. Eat small portions.
week7_tips: Rest well. Feeling tired is normal.
week9_tips: Drink plenty water an eat local fruits.
week10_tips: Yu womb big like a orange now.
week11_tips: Cravings an food turn-offs are normal.
week12_tips: First ultrasound recommended. First trimester almost done.
week13_tips: Nausea might start fi ease up.
week14_tips: Second trimester. Many women feel more energy.
week15_tips: Sleep on yu side, left side better.
week16_tips: Prenatal check: blood pressure an weight.
week17_tips: Wear comfortable clothes. Yu belly starting fi show.
week18_tips: Structural ultrasound recommended between week 18 an 22.
week19_tips: Eat iron-rich food: beans, egg, meat.
week23_tips: Monthly prenatal check per MINSA guidelines.
week26_tips: Keep up a gentle walking routine.
week27_tips: Heartburn is normal. Eat small portions.
week28_tips: Third trimester. Start counting kicks every day.
week30_tips: Pack yu hospital bag or maternity house bag.
week31_tips: Rest an put up yu feet if dem swell.
week32_tips: Know where yu nearest health center or maternity house deh.
week35_tips: Have yu transport plan ready fi di hospital.
week37_tips: Yu baby can come any time. Stay ready.
week38_tips: Rest but keep active wid short walks.
week39_tips: Check yu bag packed an yu birth plan clear.
week40_tips: Due date. If no signs, talk to yu doctor.
week6_exams: First prenatal visit. Full physical exam.
week7_exams: Blood count, blood type, HIV, VDRL, urine test.
week8_exams: Follow up per first visit instructions.
week15_exams: Prenatal check: weight, pressure, uterine height.
week20_exams: Structural ultrasound if not done yet.
week27_exams: Blood count check. Tetanus vaccine if due.
week40_exams: Fetal wellbeing assessment. Plan induction if needed.
faq_cycle_what_is_content: Di menstrual cycle is a natural body process dat last between 21 an 35 days. It have 4 phases: period, growing, ovulation an waiting. Every month yu body get ready fi a possible pregnancy.
faq_cycle_irregular: Is it normal fi mi period fi be irregular?
faq_cycle_irregular_content: It common fi cycles fi vary a little every month. If yu cycle change plenty or last more dan 35 days inna row, go di health center.
faq_cycle_pain_content: Small or medium pain during yu period is normal. If di pain too bad an yu cyaan do yu things, go di health center.
faq_cycle_fertile: How mi know when mi fertile?
faq_cycle_fertile_content: Di fertile window usually happen between day 10 an 17 of a 28-day cycle. Metztli help yu calculate it automatically.
faq_pregnancy_signs: What are di first signs of pregnancy?
faq_pregnancy_signs_content: First signs can be: late period, morning sickness, tender breasts, tiredness an smell changes. A pregnancy test confirm it.
faq_pregnancy_prenatal_content: Prenatal care help detect an prevent complications early. Per MINSA, yu should have at least 4 checkups during pregnancy.
faq_pregnancy_danger: What are di danger signs inna pregnancy?
faq_pregnancy_danger_content: Get help right now if yu have: bleeding, bad belly pain, blurry vision, face or hand swelling, high fever, or baby nah moving.
faq_pregnancy_nutrition_content: Eat variety: beans, rice, eggs, meat, fish, local fruits an vegetables. Drink plenty water, milk if yu can, an avoid alcohol.
faq_pregnancy_kicks: How fi count mi baby kicks?
faq_pregnancy_kicks_content: From week 28, lie on yu side an count movements. Yu should feel at least 10 movements inna 2 hours. If less, seek medical attention.
faq_menopause_what_is_content: Menopause is when yu stop menstruating permanently, usually between age 45 an 55. It a natural body process.
faq_menopause_hotflash_content: Hot flashes are sudden waves of heat dat can last a few minutes. Dem very common during menopause an usually get better wid time.
faq_menopause_bones: How fi tek care of mi bones after menopause?
faq_menopause_bones_content: Eat calcium-rich food (milk, cheese, corn tortilla), walk at least 30 minutes every day, an get morning sun fi vitamin D.
faq_plants_chamomile_content: Chamomile help yu relax an can ease mild cramps. Drink it as tea. Ask before using it if yu pregnant.
faq_plants_ginger_content: Ginger can help wid pregnancy nausea. Yu can chew a small piece or drink it as tea. Use small amounts.
faq_plants_cinnamon_content: Cinnamon traditionally used fi ease period cramps. Not recommended during pregnancy inna large amounts.
